company.shortDescription: Pluang is a financial technology application that provides access to stocks, crypto, and gold to enhance access to various asset classes.
company.description: Pluang is a financial technology platform that provides access to multiple investment products, including cryptocurrencies, U.S. stocks and ETFs, Indonesian stocks, mutual funds, and gold through a single application. The platform also offers trading features such as options trading, crypto futures, leverage tools, and web-based trading services designed for both beginner and experienced investors. In addition to investment access, Pluang provides educational resources, market news, and analytical tools intended to help users make informed financial decisions. The company states that its services are supervised by Indonesian financial regulators through licensed partners and that it focuses on expanding access to financial products for a wider range of users. Pluang has evolved from an initial focus on gold investment into a broader multi-asset investment platform serving millions of registered users in Indonesia.
